About Us

Technology with a purpose. A team focused on your next step.

NEXVORX INDIA TECHNOLOGIES

Your ideas.

Based in Raipur, India, Nexvorx brings together custom application development, AI solutions, technology consulting, and digital marketing.

We work from the problem outward: understand your business, define a useful solution, and build with clear communication and engineering oversight.

Our SchollyGo product family supports students in Grades 3–12 and school administration, reflecting our interest in practical technology for learning and everyday operations.
